title: A sky, received four ways.
subtitle: UDP  ·  SHARED MEMORY  ·  FILE  ·  RAW FEED  /  One sky through each way in, and what each says about itself.
footer: sender.py sends both sky doors and pulse.py the raw feed  ·  Edit data/sky.json and save  ·  Captures replay the recordings under data/

doors.label: UDP · SCHEMA
doors.note: A datagram per sky, read through feed_sky.fbs: an arrival that does not fit the schema is counted, never drawn.

doors.label: SHARED MEMORY · JSON
doors.note: A region another process on this machine wrote, mapped read-only: no socket and no copy through the kernel.

file.label: FILE · SCHEMA JSON
file.note: The schema's own JSON form, converted through feed_sky.fbs and watched: a saved edit is a new sky.

raw.label: RAW FEED · BYTES
raw.note: receive() drains every arrival in order onto the strip; latest() keeps the newest message whatever the queue dropped.
